method: Every live fact was read (reg-dump.txt, built by reg_dump.py). Decisions in reg-decisions.json, displays in reg-displays.json, scopes in reg-scopes.json; patches in reg-patches/ built by reg_build.py (it checks that every number-free display is a verbatim phrase of a quote with at most 8 words); applied one CLI command at a time by reg_apply.py (log reg-apply-log.jsonl; one expected failure: cf-0410 had already been closed by hand). Demand statuses by reg_demand.py with reg-demand-map.json. After state: reg-analysis-after.txt; facts verify --chapter 27: 825 ok.
rules_applied: Duplicates: 106 superseded. Same sentence quoted by two lenses (numbers vs behavior vs faq): kept the fact with a scope, the shorter verbatim display or more quotes; bullets and the higher exam relevance merged into the kept fact. FAQ facts that restate a guide sentence on another page were kept for the FAQ quick-fire.

Namespace: 21 facts moved by supersession: RDS Proxy facts to rds-proxy (11), RDS facts to rds (6: decision-guide RDS row, read replica asynchronous copy, Multi-AZ standby reads, no read replica autoscaling), DynamoDB and ElastiCache decision-guide rows and the DynamoDB global table fact to dynamodb (3), inter-AZ encryption to global-infrastructure (1); aurora-db-serverless-class-adjusts-resources re-added as aurora-serverless-db-serverless-instance-class-type (its quote did not name db.serverless). Facts whose claim added an unquoted Aurora comparison (cmp-dynamodb, cmp-rds read replica, sec-kerberos) were superseded for that reason too.

Rejected (outdated FAQ text): aurora-faq-cross-region-replicas-global-db-five-regions (now up to 10 secondary Regions), aurora-faq-delete-drops-automated-backups (retained automated backups since 2023-08-04).

Displays: 269 number-free displays cut to verbatim phrases of at most 8 words (RULINGS 2026-10-11); 17 redundant long displays dropped where the fact kept another display; one display added (aurora-cmp-ha-az-failure-no-data-loss-brief-interruption: only a brief interruption of service).
Qualifiers: scope filled on 494 facts that had none.
hard set to true on 32 claims with a number, number word or restriction wording (only, cannot, must, up to, free, not supported).
for_the_writers: Throughput: current pages say up to 6x for both engines (aurora-throughput-up-to-6x-stock-mysql-and-postgresql); the decision guide still says five times for MySQL (reference only).
Global Database secondary Regions: up to 10 (aurora-global-secondary-regions-max-10, changed from 5 on 2025-05-21).

Promotion of a secondary Region: product page and FAQ say under 1 minute (aurora-global-promote-secondary-under-1-minute); the guide says RTO in the order of minutes and managed failover typically within a few minutes. Keep the source with the number.

Encryption: Aurora clusters must be in a VPC (aurora-security-vpc-required-security-group) while the FAQ describes express configuration without a VPC (reference, newer path). New clusters are encrypted by default since 2026-02-18 (change facts).
Aurora serverless instance-hour vs ACU billing: ACU-hours (aurora-serverless-billing-unit-acu-hours) and per-second ACU usage (FAQ).

The registry sources of chapter 27 do not list the three pages fetched in this stage (rds-proxy-gdb, aurora-poc, the Aurora SLA page); they are in the corpus. A registry change was not made, so the ledger hashes stay valid.
